overview_description.description:
Tipjoy is a simple, social payments engine that allows merchants to sell digital content and features, charities to raise money for causes, and individuals to give money to one another.

Tipjoy was a Winter '08 [Y Combinator](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/y-combinator) participant.

Patreon is an online platform connecting musicians and other artists with their fan base.
Ko-fi is a platform that allows individuals to create pages to display their work and gain support.
